model_id: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 family, exact serving revision unverified)

correctness_confidence.basis: The economic cut is floor(A N/B)+1. Monotonicity places K survivors in the accessible frame under the least favorable null. The equal-register extremizers sum to 81,618, and the two reported probabilities refer to different randomized designs.

rigor.basis: The product-weight law cancels the capacity factors, and the pair transfer maximizes e_k with upper bounds. In the symmetric band used for the boundary, the maximizing success profile fits even the smallest admissible block. Thus the worst capacity denominator and success numerator are jointly attained.

novelty.basis: Product-weight sampling, hypergeometric probabilities and pair transfers are established. The sharp, case-specific 437-position robustness radius and contrast between spatial observation rules add a reproducible consequence to this proposed budget. General methodological priority is unestablished.

significance.basis: The same number of verified plants can produce radically different evidence depending on the sampling frame. The result can guide planning, but requires a fixed register and horizon and does not estimate field survival or the number of successful audits.

reproducibility.basis: The companion includes count inputs, exact rational probabilities, witnesses and finite exhaustive checks. The source PDF and manuscript are pinned and the latter reproduced twice. There are no implementation data with which to check model fit.

summary: I inspected all three rendered pages and the version-specific evidence. Sections 3 and 4 show why 13 successful checks in one selected block can coexist with a high probability of a false certification while a prespecified dispersed design controls that probability. The one-nursery reduction has a clear estimand. The arithmetic spending comparison in Section 5 is conditional on an unmeasured cost response. The PDF is legible and suitable as an analytical working paper.
strengths: The unequal-capacity argument states the precise subset selection law and gives a way to implement it.
The prospective use is separated from claims about measured survival.
weaknesses: Operating power at realistic intermediate survival levels and travel costs are not quantified.
The fixed-cost sensitivity uses a benchmark quoted in the source without direct administrative scope verification.
A small table listing all three designs and their denominators could help practitioners distinguish sampling positions from sampling hectares.
potential_errors: A frame that omits empty planting positions, replaces inaccessible draws selectively, or uses successive proportional sampling instead of product weights would not realize the stated test.
A one-sided five-percent test does not make the probability of the null conditional on an observed pass five percent.
An implemented project could depart from the published budgets and densities and would need a recalculated threshold.
strong_novelty_candidates: Sharp sensitivity of a 13-visit certification to registered block capacities in the specified plan, with matching integer failure witness one position beyond the tolerance.
